# Cold War Project: CWP flag definitions per tag, input of tools/flags/gen_flags.py.
# One block per tag: the CWP flag_definitions (start flag at 900, see the priority scheme in the
# generated file's header), followed by optional generator directives:
#   cwp_drop_vanilla = { COA ... }   drop these vanilla definitions of the tag
#   cwp_keep_vanilla = { COA ... }   keep these even if the generator would drop them
#   cwp_drop_vanilla_pattern = "re"  drop vanilla definitions whose coa matches this regular expression
#   cwp_no_vanilla = yes             do not merge any vanilla definition (the tag means something else in CWP)
# Reconstructed on 2026-11-17 from the generated file of CWP2 bbaffa2b0 (the original gen_flags.py was lost).

ABI = {	# Abyssinia: Ethiopian tricolour with the Lion of Judah
	flag_definition = {
		coa = ETH
		subject_canton = ETH
		priority = 900
	}
	flag_definition = {	# as Ethiopia: without the monarchy (1974)
		coa = cwp_ETH_derg
		subject_canton = cwp_ETH_derg
		priority = 1650
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_national_republic_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# as Ethiopia: People's Democratic Republic (1987)
		coa = cwp_ETH_pdre
		subject_canton = cwp_ETH_pdre
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_peoples_republic_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# as Ethiopia: Federal Democratic Republic (1996)
		coa = cwp_ETH_fdre
		subject_canton = cwp_ETH_fdre
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_democratic_republic_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	cwp_drop_vanilla = { ETH_republic }
	cwp_vanilla_list = ETH
}

AFH = {	# Kingdom of Afghanistan
	flag_definition = {
		coa = cwp_AFH_1946
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_1946
		priority = 900
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Democratic Republic of Afghanistan (1978): people's republic not under a Soviet overlord
		coa = cwp_AFH_democratic_republic
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_democratic_republic
		priority = 1700
		trigger = {
			cwp_coa_def_peoples_republic_flag_trigger = yes
			NOT = { scope:overlord ?= { c:RUS ?= this } }
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Islamic Emirate (1997)
		coa = cwp_AFH_islamic_emirate
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_islamic_emirate
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_islamic_emirate_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Republic of Afghanistan (1973, Daoud): non-communist republic under one-man, one-party or military rule
		coa = cwp_AFH_republic
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_republic
		priority = 1650
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_republican_dictatorship_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Democratic Republic of Afghanistan (1980, Karmal): communist one-party state under a Soviet overlord
		coa = cwp_AFH_1980
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_1980
		priority = 1700
		trigger = {
			coa_def_communist_flag_trigger = yes
			scope:overlord ?= { c:RUS ?= this }
			cwp_coa_def_peoples_democracy_flag_trigger = no
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Republic of Afghanistan (1987, Najibullah's national reconciliation): communist-led with other parties allowed (people's democracy)
		coa = cwp_AFH_1987
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_1987
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_peoples_democracy_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Islamic State of Afghanistan (1992, mujahideen government): Islamic republic
		coa = cwp_AFH_islamic_state
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_islamic_state
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_islamic_republic_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	cwp_vanilla_list = AFG
}

CWP_GENERIC = {	# Generic regime flags: the generator appends each to every list above unless the list already has a flag for that regime (cwp_unless_trigger) or names its coa in cwp_no_generic
	flag_definition = {	# Islamic republic or emirate: random green Islamic flag (template list cwp_islamic)
		coa = list "cwp_islamic"
		priority = 901
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_islamic_theocracy_flag_trigger = yes }
		cwp_unless_trigger = { coa_def_theocracy_flag_trigger cwp_coa_def_islamic_theocracy_flag_trigger cwp_coa_def_islamic_republic_flag_trigger cwp_coa_def_islamic_emirate_flag_trigger }
	}
}
